name: Hotpoint HDM67G0C2CX/U — Gas (NG) Freestanding Cooker — Convertible
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Hotpoint HDM67G0C2CX is a 60cm double-oven gas cooker with two fan ovens (up to 84L, six shelf levels) and a four-burner gas hob including a Triple Crown wok burner that cooks up to 15% faster. It's LPG-convertible for homes without natural gas, with 10-level flame control, a flame-failure device and catalytic liners. A+ energy rated.
